blocking.fact: There is NO mechanism anywhere in the codebase to capture cost/usage from interactive PTY sessions: bare interactive claude on ConPTY emits no stream-json result envelope, and nothing parses the engine's own session/usage records. The capture approach for interactive sessions is an OPEN DESIGN QUESTION (e.g. parse the engine's session JSONL/usage output, wrap the launch, or query a usage API), not merely an unwired existing path.

salvage.question: Salvage the existing implementation, or rewrite from scratch? This is your call — Crucible surfaces the facts and trade-offs but does not score it.
salvage.note: Crucible never scores salvage-vs-rewrite (it lacks the org facts; the common "40%" rewrite heuristic is UNVERIFIED). Decide, then pass salvageAnswer to lock.

framing.northStar: Every Anchor session — interactive ConPTY or one-shot job — leaves an honest, machine-verified trail of what it cost and what it accomplished, so the project rollup's numbers mean 'measured truth, not zero-by-omission,' and clicking ANY session tile reliably opens a warm terminal that narrates what was done, what was produced, and what comes next.
criteria: Interactive PTY sessions capture real usage: a usage-capture seam on the terminal_session path (e.g. the engine's own session JSONL sidecar) produces a RUN-provenance effort with a real cost block (tokens/time/$), finalized on every end path (finish, kill, close/park, reconcile-dead) — verified by a STUB-GATE suite with a pinned sidecar fixture, and by one live smoke run whose rollup delta matches the sidecar's reported usage.

Honesty contract holds and is test-pinned: discovered/imported efforts still contribute exactly 0; a session whose usage genuinely cannot be captured surfaces an explicit 'unmeasured' state distinct from $0.00 in the rollup UI; no cost is ever estimated, interpolated, or fabricated — existing v4 rollup and v8 persist suites stay green unmodified.

No double-counting: a session's persisted docs (source=discovered) and its new RUN cost record coexist without inflating the rollup — dedup keyed on session_id proven by a test that persists docs AND attaches cost for the same session, asserting the rollup counts the cost exactly once.

The diag-B2 tile inconsistencies are REPRODUCED first (Playwright against captured registry-state fixtures: large-tile blank window, context-free blue restart, manual orientation), then fixed: after the fix, every tile class (running, parked-idle, done, failed, discovered/brownfield) click-opens a non-blank session window in Playwright with a screenshot sign-off.

Resume narrates and orients: clicking a parked/done/discovered tile starts a session whose read-only orientation prompt AUTO-EXECUTES (loads docs/summary and prints what was done / accomplished / produced / next steps in the terminal), while any mutating/ACTION prompt remains v10 paste-NOT-submit — the fork is resolved, locked in the North Star doc, and pinned by a test asserting no ACTION prompt is ever auto-submitted.

All constraints preserved: Python stdlib-only (pywinpty exception) passes distro.py's import scan; tests never touch the live :8777 service (stub PTY + ANCHOR_RUNNER_CMD + fake sidecar fixtures); resume/advance tests follow the v11/v11.1 lessons (worktree-only, conversation-only seeds the stub PTY buffer); the daily healthcheck gains a stubbed walk of the new capture+finalize path.

The undercount is measured once: a before/after comparison on at least one real project quantifies how much spend the rollup was missing (turning derived-I1 from inferred to observed) and is recorded in the execution log.
nonGoals: NOT a billing/analytics platform: no historical backfill of past sessions' costs (pre-fix sessions stay honestly at 0/unmeasured), no re-pricing engine, no live cost ticker streaming into the terminal.
NOT a change to the honesty contract: discovered→0 semantics, the never-fabricate rule, and the RUN-provenance-only rollup principle are extended to PTY sessions, never weakened or special-cased.
NOT full auto-drive: mutating/ACTION handoff prompts stay paste-NOT-submit per v10; auto-execution is scoped to the read-only orientation only. Anchor never submits work on the user's behalf.
NOT Gemini usage parity: if the Gemini engine exposes no equivalent usage sidecar, its sessions surface the honest 'unmeasured' state — cross-engine capture parity is future work, not a blocker.

NOT the v12 'Efforts' merge: this effort lands on master's deployed truth (v11.1 + crucible-improve waves); v12 integration is a separate decision — but cost records are keyed so they survive a later v12 regroup.
NOT a redesign of the project window/board layout: only the tile-click reliability and the resume narrative are in scope, not new lanes, columns, or visual paradigms.

riskTaxonomy.risk: The engine's session JSONL sidecar is an undocumented, version-unstable format — a CLI update silently changes fields and capture breaks or, worse, mis-reports.
riskTaxonomy.mitigation: Isolate parsing behind a single seam module with a version-tolerant parser; unknown/missing fields degrade to the honest 'unmeasured' state (never a guess); pin a fixture captured from the live CLI as the stub, and add a healthcheck warn (not red) if a live sidecar fails to parse.

riskTaxonomy.risk: Correlating a PTY session to the right sidecar file is ambiguous (multiple concurrent sessions, shared cwd, engine switches mid-session) → cost attaches to the wrong session.
riskTaxonomy.mitigation: Deterministic correlation established at launch (per-session worktree cwd + launch timestamp window + engine session id when emitted); on any ambiguity REFUSE to attach and mark unmeasured; W7-style engine-switch path captures per-segment so a switch never merges two engines' usage.

riskTaxonomy.risk: Introducing RUN-provenance PTY efforts breaks the test-pinned discovered→0 semantics or double-counts against the persisted-docs effort for the same session.
riskTaxonomy.mitigation: Cost lives on a NEW dedicated effort record type keyed by session_id (docs stay source=discovered untouched); rollup dedup extends the existing (store_lane, job_id) rule; the full v4/v8 suites run unmodified as the regression gate before any wave merges.

riskTaxonomy.risk: Auto-executing the orientation violates the locked v10 paste-NOT-submit convention or auto-runs something destructive on an unattended resume.
riskTaxonomy.mitigation: Resolve and LOCK the fork at Stage 0: orientation prompts are generated read-only (load/read/summarize verbs only), flagged auto_execute=true explicitly; everything else defaults to pending_paste; a test asserts an ACTION/handoff prompt is never flushed with a submit.

riskTaxonomy.risk: The blank-window / blue-restart bugs get 'fixed' from an assumed root cause without a repro, and the symptom persists (or the fix regresses working tile classes).
riskTaxonomy.mitigation: Repro-first discipline: capture the failing registry-record shapes from the live .anchor store into fixtures, reproduce under Playwright, THEN fix; the fix wave's exit gate is the same Playwright walk green across all five tile classes plus screenshots.

riskTaxonomy.risk: Finalize-on-kill/close races PTY teardown or the summary hook — usage read after the sidecar is reaped, or a wedged read blocks the close path.
riskTaxonomy.mitigation: Capture usage BEFORE reap (the W7 handoff-digest pattern): bounded daemon-thread read with a module-global timeout, fail-open (close/kill always proceeds), idempotent finalize so a retry never double-attaches.

riskTaxonomy.risk: New capture/finalize logic drags real model calls or the live :8777 service into tests or the 5 AM healthcheck.
riskTaxonomy.mitigation: Everything behind existing seams (ANCHOR_PTY_BACKEND=stub, ANCHOR_RUNNER_CMD, temp ANCHOR_WORKTREE_BASE) plus a new sidecar-fixture seam; the healthcheck walk is fully stubbed and any timing measurement uses report.warn per the locked severity rule.

framing.foresightBrief: Three steps ahead: (1) v12 'Efforts' will regroup sessions into single-effort chains — key every cost record by session_id AND chain_id now, and store raw per-segment usage (engine, model id, timestamps, token classes) rather than a pre-summed total, so the v12 view and any future re-pricing can re-aggregate without recapture. (2) Ship-Anchor-v1 puts this in collaborators' hands on other hosts/subscriptions — keep the capture seam engine-agnostic (a per-engine sidecar adapter table, honest-unmeasured for engines without one) and env-stubbable, and token-auth any new endpoint from day one because the Tailscale/app exposure plan makes every route remote-reachable. (3) The auto-executing read-only orientation is the natural substrate for unattended/scheduled warm resume (cron 'morning brief' sessions) — persist the orientation prompt as a durable worktree artifact (ORIENTATION.md beside NEXT-PROMPT.md), not an inline string, so a later scheduler can reuse it verbatim. Capture now, decide later: log the sidecar's full result envelope per session even where the rollup only needs totals — per-model splits and the 5:1 swarm attribution question (Claude-orchestrates-Gemini) will need it, and it cannot be reconstructed after the worktree is reaped.
